inputs.xtext_rule_text:
fragment DifferencingPart returns SysML::Type :
	'differences' ownedRelationship += Differencing
	( ',' ownedRelationship += Differencing )* 
;

decision: As KerML 8.2.4.1.1 states it: 'differences', then one or more Differencing separated by commas. The Xtext fragment is identical. The leading keyword is unique among TypeRelationshipPart's four alternatives in the same clause (`disjoint from`, `unions`, `intersects`, `differences`), so the alternatives do not overlap. TypeDeclaration, in the same clause, repeats relationship parts with `TypeRelationshipPart*`, so the same part may occur more than once. Repeating the keyword and continuing the comma list both accept a further target.

evidence.note: DifferencingPart : Type = 'differences' ownedRelationship += Differencing ( ',' ownedRelationship += Differencing )*
line 13: `classifier D disjoint from C differences A, B;`
fragment DifferencingPart: 'differences' ownedRelationship += Differencing ( ',' ownedRelationship += Differencing )*. Agrees.

notes: re-scoped (ADR-0015): only the kerml grammar reaches this production, so its work now lives in DifferencingPart@kerml
